food.title: Food
food.description: Three principles for food preparation: no cooking required, high nutritional value with sufficient calories to support physical strength, and long shelf life.

water.name: Water
water.description: 3 liters of water per person per day to properly hydrate the body
water.note: During disasters, each person needs 2-3 liters of drinking water per day, more may be needed in summer or high-temperature environments

instant_food.name: Instant Rice, Cookies, Instant Noodles
instant_food.description: Staple food providing carbohydrate energy source
instant_food.note: Choose foods that don't require cooking or only need simple heating, providing basic calories

protein_can.name: Protein Cans (Tuna/Chicken)
protein_can.note: Cans have long shelf life, at least one serving of protein food per day to maintain strength

high_calorie.name: High Calorie (Energy Bars/Chocolate)
high_calorie.description: High-calorie food supplementing fat and quick energy
high_calorie.note: High energy density, providing quick energy and psychological satisfaction

electrolyte.name: Electrolyte Powder
electrolyte.description: Supplement electrolytes to maintain fluid balance and mental alertness
electrolyte.note: Prevent dehydration and maintain electrolyte balance, especially during diarrhea or excessive sweating

medical.title: Medical & Hygiene
medical.description: Medical and hygiene supplies preparation principles: basic first aid, personal hygiene, chronic disease medications.

first_aid.name: First Aid Kit
first_aid.description: Basic wound treatment and first aid supplies
first_aid.note: Includes gauze, bandages, disinfectant and other basic first aid items

living.title: Living Supplies
living.description: Living supplies preparation principles: personal hygiene, warmth, lighting.

toilet_paper.name: Toilet Paper
toilet_paper.note: Choose high-quality toilet paper that doesn't tear easily

info.title: Electronics & Communication
info.description: Electronics and communication equipment preparation principles: multiple backup power sources, multiple communication methods.

battery.name: Batteries
battery.note: Prepare multiple types to meet different device requirements

tools.title: Tools
tools.description: Tools preparation principles: multifunctional, durable, easy to use.

flashlight.name: Flashlight
flashlight.note: Choose LED flashlight, high brightness and energy efficient
